newsitem.title: UK: UK's Berkshire awards Wellington US equity mandate.
newsitem.headline: UK's Berkshire awards Wellington US equity mandate.

text.p: The Berkshire County Council pension fund said on Friday it had appointed U.S.-based Wellington Management Co as its U.S. equity manager.
The 42 million sterling active mandate was awarded after a contest between Wellington, Scudder, Stevens & Clark and IDS Asset Management, said Berkshire fund manager Jack Johnson.
The change was part of Berkshire's full review of overseas asset management operations. It has about 146 million sterling in overseas equities of an overall 714 million sterling fund.
Gartmore earlier in the week was awarded a 36 million sterling continental European mandate and Schroders Plc was recently awarded its 38 million sterling Japanese mandate.
The previous manager for the overseas mandates was PDFM.
